# Draft:Backwardks (baseball media)

backwardks
backwardks is a baseball-focused social media brand established on March 28, 2021. The brand creates both long and short-form content covering all levels of baseball, from Little League to Major League Baseball (MLB).
History and Founding
backwardks was launched on March 28, 2021, with the goal of creating engaging and entertaining baseball content for fans of all ages. Since its inception, it has grown into a prominent social media presence within the baseball community, accumulating over 200,000 followers across platforms.
Content and Focus
backwardks is known for its diverse content offerings, which appeal to both casual and avid baseball fans. The platform shares:
Game Highlights: Showcasing the best moments from baseball games at all levels.
Bloopers: Funny and unexpected moments from the field.
Trick Plays: Clever and innovative plays that showcase player skill and creativity.
Player Features: Spotlights on standout players, both amateur and professional.
Fan Engagement: Content that invites fans to participate and share their opinions.
Platforms
backwardks maintains an active presence on multiple social media platforms, including:
Long and short-form content, including in-depth analyses.
Short-form, fast-paced highlights and viral moments.
Short-form, fast-paced highlights and viral moments.
Real-time updates, discussions, and fan interactions.
